reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: DISPUTED_FP: Code reading is partially correct but the finding misunderstands the design. Verified message_router.nim:161-167 broadcasts all 128 columns and nimbus_beacon_node.nim:1350-1352 subscribes only to custody subnets (~8-16). However, this is BY DESIGN for PeerDAS proposer behavior. Proposers MUST broadcast all columns for network-wide availability. The libp2p layer gracefully handles unsubscribed publishes via eth2_network.nim:2650 returning err('No peers on libp2p topic') - NOT a protocol violation, crash, or reputation penalty. Failures are logged as 'notice' and processing continues normally. Gossipsub protocol does not forbid publishing to unsubscribed topics; nodes simply lack peers to deliver to. The 01e property (outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json:914-930) may misinterpret the PeerDAS specification - proposers must publish all columns regardless of subscription status. No exploitability: only operational effect is expected message delivery failure when no peers exist on unsubscribed subnets, which is normal PeerDAS behavior.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: 01e inv-036: 'Publishing data columns must only occur on subnets the node is subscribed to' - This constraint conflicts with PeerDAS proposer requirements to broadcast all columns.
